prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1498; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Physical examination demonstrated focal tenderness over the distal radius, restricted range of motion, and reduced grip strength. Radiographs confirmed a distal radius fracture, and the findings are clear and consistent with the mechanism described, with the force of the impact being in keeping with this type of injury. The patient has no known prior injury to this area. Management consisted of immobilization in a splint, analgesia as needed, and a structured home exercise program once healing allowed. Over four visits, the patient progressed steadily, with pain and swelling decreasing and mobility improving, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as recovery advanced. Billed services reflect the expected sequence of care, with no duplicated charges for the same treatment. Continued follow-up is planned to monitor union and functional recovery.
